_meta.title: Computed subway access to starred restaurants

method.edge_weight: median scheduled stop-to-stop running time across trips in the current GTFS feed
method.walk_model: haversine x 1.3 street-detour factor at 75 m/min
method.calendar_note: GTFS in force at capture time; it does NOT describe Feb-Mar 2027 and must not be read as a 2027 timetable.
method.excluded: starred restaurants whose street address was not captured in data/michelin_all.json (see excluded_restaurants); no address was inferred

_meta.caveat: Computed from the CURRENT MTA subway GTFS feed (median scheduled running times, walking included). This is not a Feb-Mar 2027 timetable, includes no bus service, and covers only the starred restaurants whose street address was captured. Treat as a comparative ranking, not a journey promise.

sources.label: US Census Bureau batch geocoder (benchmark Public_AR_Current)

_meta.address_coverage: 33 of 72 starred restaurants have a captured street address and are included; 39 do not and are excluded rather than guessed.
